criterion_descriptions: From the specified USGS event executive page, record (a) the event title exactly as shown and (b) the displayed coordinates exactly as shown. Full credit for correct title and coordinate pair as displayed on the executive page. If the page or the relevant executive display is inaccessible/blocked/fails to load, award full credit if the agent clearly states this limitation and indicates it attempted to retrieve the title/coordinates from the executive page. Partial credit if only one of the two (title or coordinates) is reported, or if formatting differs but values are clearly the same.

Report the MMI shown in the 'Did You Feel It?' executive card (community intensity) and keep it distinct from ShakeMap. Full credit for the exact MMI value as displayed. If the DYFI executive card is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports that it cannot access the DYFI MMI on the executive card despite attempting to. Partial credit if an intensity is reported but DYFI attribution is unclear.

Report the MMI shown in the 'ShakeMap' executive card (estimated intensity) and keep it distinct from DYFI. Full credit for the exact MMI value as displayed. If the ShakeMap executive card is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports that it cannot access the ShakeMap MMI on the executive card despite attempting to. Partial credit if an intensity is reported but ShakeMap attribution is unclear.

From the 'Ground Failure' executive card, record the Landslide Estimate area statement and the population exposure wording as shown, paired correctly with the Landslide estimate (not liquefaction). Full credit for both area and population exposure wording correctly captured and attributed. If the Ground Failure card/landslide section is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot access the landslide estimate text from the executive card despite attempting to. Partial credit if only area or only population exposure is captured, or wording is lightly paraphrased but meaning is preserved.

From the 'Ground Failure' executive card, record the Liquefaction Estimate area statement and the population exposure wording as shown, paired correctly with the Liquefaction estimate (not landslide). Full credit for both area and population exposure wording correctly captured and attributed. If the Ground Failure card/liquefaction section is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot access the liquefaction estimate text from the executive card despite attempting to. Partial credit if only area or only population exposure is captured, or wording is lightly paraphrased but meaning is preserved.

From the labeled 'Origin' executive card (not the narrative summary), report: Review Status, Magnitude including its type, Depth, Time, and the displayed contributor. Full credit for all five fields accurately captured as displayed. If the Origin card is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot access the Origin card fields despite attempting to. Partial credit if one or two fields are missing/mislabeled but the rest are correct.
